response.original_title: What is the difference between 2 BHK and 3 BHK?
response.overview: A 2 BHK vs 3 BHK comparison is one of the most common decisions for homebuyers. A 2 BHK offers two bedrooms, a hall, and a kitchen, making it a perfect choice for young couples, small families, and first-time buyers. It is more budget-friendly, requires lower maintenance, and helps reduce monthly expenses. On the other hand, a 3 BHK provides an additional bedroom, giving you extra space for children, guests, a home office, or elderly family members. While the price is higher, the added space offers greater comfort and convenience for families planning for the future.  https://www.laxmigroup.co/articles/2-bhk-vs-3-bhk-in-ahmedabad-why-the-2-bedroom-is-winning/
